social_brawl_minor.title: A Disagreement Escalates
social_brawl_minor.description: Tensions boiled over. [initiator_name] and [target_name] came to blows over a petty dispute during morning forms.

effects.text: I severely beat [target_name] in a brawl.

opt_restrain.text: Teach them a lesson, but hold back.

effects.text: I sparred with [target_name] to settle a dispute.

internal_duel_challenge.title: A Challenge on the Training Ground
internal_duel_challenge.description: [initiator_name] publicly challenges a sect brother to a formal duel to prove their superiority. The training ground falls silent.

opt_accept_formally.text: Bow and accept. Victory brings prestige.

effects.text: I issued a formal challenge to prove my superiority.

opt_refuse.text: Refuse with contempt. They are beneath notice.

effects.text: I refused to dignify their challenge. They are not worthy of my blade.

disciple_defects.title: Betrayal in the Night
disciple_defects.description: [initiator_name] has vanished in the night, taking stolen technique manuals with them. Rumor says they have joined a rival sect.

effects.text: A disciple defected from [initiator_sect_name], taking stolen scrolls.

opt_let_go.text: Let them go. Good riddance to faithless disciples.

effects.text: I let the traitor flee. Chasing them would cost more than they are worth.

romantic_rivalry.title: Hearts and Blades
romantic_rivalry.description: [initiator_name] and a rival disciple are both infatuated with the same person, and their rivalry has grown sharp enough to affect training.

opt_step_back.text: Step back gracefully. The heart must not rule the blade.

effects.text: I stepped aside in the matter of the heart. Discipline above emotion.

opt_confront_rival.text: Settle it with a duel. Winner takes all.

effects.text: I challenged my rival for the right to pursue the one I desire.
